name: Warrior's Oath
desc: Warrior starting point

name: Ranger's Path
desc: Ranger starting point

name: Mage's Sigil
desc: Mage starting point

name: Brutal Force
desc: Melee hits against Stunned or Frozen enemies are always critical strikes. 12% increased melee damage, 5% increased attack speed.

name: Overwhelming Momentum
desc: Each consecutive hit within 2s grants 3% more damage, up to 20 stacks. Stacks are lost when you stop attacking. You deal 10% less damage with your first hit.
drawback: You deal 10% less damage with your first hit, and stacks are lost when you stop attacking.

name: Bulwark Mastery
desc: Blocking a hit grants 15% damage reduction for 2 seconds

name: Fortress of Flesh
desc: While stationary for 1 second, gain 30% damage reduction. 15% reduced movement speed.
drawback: 15% reduced movement speed.

name: Second Wind
desc: When a hit leaves you below 35% life, recover 20% of your maximum life over 4 seconds (20 second cooldown). 8% increased maximum life, +1.5 life regeneration.

name: Deadeye Mastery
desc: Projectile hits against enemies more than 160 units away Snare them for 1.5 seconds. +1 pierce, 8% increased projectile damage.

name: Perfect Aim
desc: Projectile hits against enemies further than 180 units deal 30% more damage. Hits against enemies closer than 70 units deal 25% less damage. +50% increased critical chance.
drawback: Projectile hits against enemies closer than 70 units deal 25% less damage.

name: Engineer's Doctrine
desc: Turret and trap hits have a 15% chance to Shock. +1 turret limit, 10% increased turret damage.

name: Automaton Doctrine
desc: Turrets deal 70% more damage. You can have 1 fewer turret (minimum 1).
drawback: You can have 1 fewer turret (minimum 1).

name: Killer Instinct
desc: Critical strikes against Chilled enemies Freeze them. +20% critical strike multiplier, 10% increased critical strike chance.

name: Pyroclasm
desc: Ignited enemies explode when they die, dealing 10% of their maximum life as fire damage to enemies within 60 units. 12% increased fire damage, +10% chance to ignite.

name: Elemental Convergence
desc: Hitting a chilled or shocked enemy with fire, or a burning enemy with ice or lightning, deals 35% more damage. 10% less damage against enemies with no status ailment.
drawback: 10% less damage against enemies with no status ailment.

name: Commander Mastery
desc: Your minions use your critical strike chance increases and critical strike multiplier. +1 minion limit, 8% increased minion speed.

name: One Mind
desc: Minions deal 60% more damage and have 30% more life. Your own spells and attacks deal 30% less damage.
drawback: Your own spells and attacks deal 30% less damage.

name: Rift Step
desc: Blink Snares enemies within 60 units of where you leave and where you arrive, for 2 seconds. 15% increased mana regeneration, 8% reduced mana cost.

name: Hunter-Knight
desc: Melee hits have a 20% chance to Mark enemies that are not Marked, for 2 seconds. Projectile hits against Marked enemies have +15% critical strike chance. 5% increased attack speed, 6% increased attack damage.

name: Hexshot
desc: The first projectile hit of each skill use applies the last curse you cast to the enemy hit. 6% increased elemental and projectile damage.

name: Spellblade
desc: Melee hits release a burst (50 units) of your last spell's element for 30% of the hit's damage: fire ignites, cold chills, lightning shocks. 0.6 second cooldown. 6% increased spell and melee damage.

name: Blood for Power
desc: Skills cost Life instead of Mana. 15% increased damage. You have no mana regeneration.
drawback: Skills cost Life instead of Mana, and you have no mana regeneration.

name: Festering Wounds
desc: Bleed, ignite and poison you inflict on Snared or Marked enemies last 50% longer. 15% increased damage over time, +6% status chance, 15% increased ailment duration.

name: Glass Cannon
desc: You deal 40% more damage. You have 40% less maximum life.
drawback: You have 40% less maximum life.

name: Opened Veins
desc: Melee critical strikes always inflict Bleed. +5% chance to inflict Bleed.

name: Blood Scent
desc: Killing a bleeding enemy restores 4% of your maximum life. 8% increased physical damage.

name: Blood Frenzy
desc: Each bleeding enemy within 150 units grants 4% more attack speed (up to 5). You take 10% more physical damage. No life regeneration while above 50% life.
drawback: You take 10% more physical damage, and you do not regenerate life while above 50% life.

name: Counterweight
desc: Blocking grants 40% increased melee damage for 2 seconds. +2% block chance.

name: Staggering Guard
desc: Blocking a hit stuns the attacker if it is within 70 units. 10% increased armour.

name: Iron Riposte
desc: Blocking triggers a free counterattack that hits all enemies within 55 units with your weapon (0.5s cooldown). +5% block chance. You cannot dodge roll; movement skills cost 50% more.
drawback: You cannot dodge roll, and movement skills cost 50% more.

name: Rallying Cry
desc: Killing a stunned enemy resets the skill with the shortest remaining cooldown. 5% increased cooldown recovery.

name: Herald's Voice
desc: Buff skills last 50% longer and stun enemies within 70 units when used. 10% increased stun threshold.

name: Volatile Mechanisms
desc: Turrets explode when they expire or are replaced; traps go off instead of fizzling. 8% increased trap damage.

name: Overclock
desc: Turrets fire 25% faster while you are within 120 units of them. 8% increased turret damage.

name: Clockwork Mind
desc: +2 maximum turrets. Turret and trap hits use your weapon's critical chance if it is higher. Your other hits deal 30% less damage.
drawback: Your own hits (not turrets, traps or minions) deal 30% less damage.

name: Agonising Toxins
desc: Your hits have 10% chance to poison. Your poisons stack up to 3 times; an enemy with 3 stacks suffers Agony. 8% increased damage over time.

name: Virulence
desc: When a poisoned enemy dies, its poison spreads to the nearest enemy within 90 units. 8% increased status duration.

name: Venom Pact
desc: Your hits have 20% chance to poison. Poisons stack (up to 20) and last 40% longer. Your hits cannot be critical strikes.
drawback: Your hits cannot be critical strikes.

name: Marked for Death
desc: Projectile critical strikes Mark the enemy for 2 seconds. Critical strikes against Marked enemies also hit one enemy nearby. 10% increased critical chance.

name: Shadowstep
desc: Dodge rolling releases a frost nova that chills enemies within 60 units. 10% increased evasion.

name: Funeral Pyre
desc: Killing an ignited enemy grants 20% increased fire damage and 10% increased cast speed for 3 seconds. 8% increased fire damage.

name: Searing Insight
desc: Hits against ignited enemies have +25% critical strike chance. +5% chance to ignite.

name: Avatar of Embers
desc: Cold and lightning damage of your skills is converted to fire. +20% chance to ignite. You cannot chill, freeze or shock: those chances ignite instead.
drawback: You cannot chill, freeze or shock.

name: Marrow Feast
desc: When one of your minions kills an enemy, it recovers 20% of its life. 10% increased minion life.

name: Necrotic Orders
desc: Minion hits have 20% chance to inflict Frailty. 8% increased minion damage.

name: Legion of Bone
desc: +2 maximum minions. Minions explode when they die, dealing 40% of their life as physical damage nearby. Minions have 30% less life; your own hits deal 20% less damage.
drawback: Minions have 30% less life, and your own hits deal 20% less damage.

name: Frailty Bloom
desc: When an enemy with Frailty dies, Frailty spreads to enemies within 80 units. 8% increased status duration.

name: Hexblight
desc: Hits against enemies with Frailty or Snare have 25% chance to inflict Agony. 8% increased damage over time.

name: Pinning Shot
desc: Projectile hits against Marked enemies Snare them for 1.5 seconds. 8% increased projectile damage.

name: Run Them Down
desc: Melee hits against Snared or Chilled enemies have +20% critical strike chance. 8% increased melee damage.

name: Twin Disciplines
desc: Using a melee skill after a projectile skill, or a projectile skill after a melee skill, makes it deal 25% more damage. Using the same kind twice in a row makes it deal 10% less. 10% increased attack damage.
drawback: Repeating a melee or projectile skill deals 10% less damage.

name: Charged Quiver
desc: Projectile hits have a 15% chance to Shock. 10% increased lightning damage.

name: Overload
desc: Killing a Shocked enemy Shocks every enemy within 80 units and deals 10% of its maximum life to them as lightning damage. 8% increased lightning damage.

name: Spell Archer
desc: Increases to spell damage also apply to your projectile attacks. 15% less attack speed.
drawback: 15% less attack speed.

name: Rime Edge
desc: Melee hits against Chilled enemies have a 25% chance to Freeze them. 10% increased cold damage.

name: Shatter
desc: Killing a Frozen enemy shatters it: enemies within 60 units are Chilled and take 10% of its maximum life as cold damage. 8% increased cold damage.

name: Battlemage's Covenant
desc: Increases to spell damage also apply to your melee attacks, and increases to melee damage also apply to your spells. 15% less maximum life.
drawback: 15% less maximum life.

name: Tremor Lines
desc: Slam hits Snare enemies for 1.5 seconds. Stuns you inflict on Snared enemies last 50% longer. 8% increased area.

name: Shockwave
desc: Killing a Stunned enemy releases a shockwave: enemies within 70 units take 10% of its maximum life as physical damage and are Stunned. 8% increased melee damage.

name: Earthbreaker
desc: Slam skills deal 35% more damage and always Stun the enemies they hit. 20% less attack speed.
drawback: 20% less attack speed.

name: Feint
desc: After a dodge roll, your next melee hit within 2 seconds is a critical strike. 10% increased critical strike chance.

name: Single Combat
desc: Melee hits against an enemy with no other enemy within 110 units Mark it for 3 seconds. 10% increased damage against elites and bosses.

name: Blade Dance
desc: Melee critical strikes grant a stack of Blade Dance for 3 seconds: 5% increased attack speed and movement speed per stack (up to 4). 6% increased attack speed.

name: Volley Fire
desc: Attacks that fire more than one projectile fire 2 more. Attacks that fire a single projectile pierce 1 more enemy. 8% increased projectile damage.

name: Arrowstorm
desc: Every 10th projectile attack hit calls down 3 volleys of arrows on the target (radius 40), each dealing 40% of that hit's damage. 6% increased attack speed.

name: Endless Quiver
desc: Projectile attacks have a 15% chance to fire a second time. 5% increased attack speed.

name: Barbed Snares
desc: Trap hits Snare enemies for 2 seconds and have a 30% chance to inflict Bleed. 10% increased trap damage.

name: Noxious Payload
desc: Trap hits poison Snared enemies. Your poisons on Snared enemies stack up to 5 times; an enemy with 5 stacks suffers Agony. 8% increased damage over time.

name: Master Trapper
desc: +1 to the maximum number of each trap. Your traps arm instantly and deal 30% more damage. You cannot deploy turrets.
drawback: You cannot deploy turrets.

name: Conductive Web
desc: When you Shock an enemy, the nearest unshocked enemy within 90 units is also Shocked. 10% increased lightning damage.

name: Thunderhead
desc: Every 4th lightning spell you cast also strikes the enemy nearest your target with a bolt for 150% of the spell's damage, Shocking it. 6% increased cast speed.

name: Static Cascade
desc: Lightning hits against Shocked enemies arc to another enemy within 100 units for 50% of the hit's damage. 10% increased lightning damage.

name: Cold Snap
desc: When you Freeze an enemy, enemies within 70 units are Chilled. 10% increased cold damage.

name: Brittle
desc: Hits against Frozen enemies have +30% critical strike chance. Freezes you inflict last 30% longer. 10% increased critical strike chance.

name: Glacial Heart
desc: Cold hits always Chill. Hits against Frozen enemies deal 40% more damage. Hits against enemies that are neither Chilled nor Frozen deal 20% less damage.
drawback: Hits against enemies that are neither Chilled nor Frozen deal 20% less damage.
